about.sectionSubtitle: Bridging corporate operations with academic cybersecurity studies at MIVA Open University.
bioParagraphs: I am an energetic cybersecurity undergraduate at MIVA Open University. Concurrently working in corporate operational systems, I manage day-to-day computing workflows while studying modern web architecture and cyber defense.
Originating from Benue State in Nigeria's Middle Belt region, I am the fourth of five children in my family. That background built my steadfast discipline, curiosity, and problem-solving focus.

careerAspirations.title: Career Aspirations
